profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hello! I'm currently a Front End Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS).

I am constantly on the hunt for cutting edge technologies to tinker with. I aim to have a solid foundation within software so that there will never be a problem I am unable to solve.

When I'm not busily coding away at my desktop, you can always find me learning a new language (currently tackling Urdu), catching up on my list of philosophy readings, or baking a new experimental batch of macarons. I'm also a passionate gamer who's always after the newest releases and supporting indie developers by beta testing and contributing ideas on the side.

Please send me a message if you have an interest in chatting!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on Confluence platform and infrastructure.

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the CloudFormation console team.

Led the Infrastructure-as-Code Generator feature to allow users to easily generate IAC templates with their own resources within AWS.

Worked on a rotation of on-call operational support involving security, devops, and customer issue investigations.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), User Interface Design and +7 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack development on a cryptocurrency analytic application using Angular/Node.js on a MongoDB/JanusGraph database. 
Created a web-app for ASCVD (atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease) risk
estimation using React.
Research and development to leverage GraphQL for FHIR health record systems.
Assisted with a technical solution as well as writing and editing the
technical section for a RFP (request for proposal).

positions.title: Undergraduate Student
positions.description:
Full-time computer science student with a focus on full-stack modern application development and cloud engineering. Active interest in cybersecurity.

Linguistics minor with a focus on Urdu and Spanish as well as dabbling in Japanese and Chinese languages.

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Cloud Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for improving the underlying infrastructure of an automated multi platform-as-a-service cloud system.
Wrote micro-services for systemic data monitoring and aggregation from international data centers. 
Created data visualizations to alert developers to deployment health and service uptimes.
positions.insights: JavaScript, Platform as a Service (PAAS) and +2 skills

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

honors.title: 2nd Place Overall
honors.description: Won second place overall at HackTX 2016 with November Sky project.

projects.title: November Sky
projects.description: A physics-based rocket simulation game that manipulates built-in code to teach programming using JavaScript. Won 2nd place at HackTX 2016.

projects.title: BoSWEmian Rhapsody
projects.description: A dynamic website using music data from Spotify and various music APIs to serve as an information hub using React, Flask, and SQLAlchemy.

organizations.name: Association for Computing Machinery
organizations.description: Weekly meetings to discuss technologies and connect with others within the computer science community at UT. Weekly competitive programming tournaments the first Friday of every month.

organizations.name: Information and Systems Security Society
organizations.description:
Weekly meetings to discuss certain cybersecurity topics
as well as participating in some capture the flag competitions. Hosted a mock DEFCON all day event during the year. Lectures on cryptography, penetration testing, and networks.
